newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but well off highs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end firm but well off highs.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures erased most of their gains as players liquidated long positions in late Tuesday trade, but the market finished firm and maintained a positive outlook, dealers said.
The lead Nikkei 225 June contract ended 55 points higher at 20,170 after hitting a peak at 20,490.
"The market is pretty jittery around these levels. So whenever it reaches a new level, some profit-taking comes in," a trader with a Japanese futures house said.
He said the June Nikkei could come off to 19,900 if the Dow came under pressure on Tuesday night.
"The daily trend is still up but we could see some corrections. Anywhere near 20,000 would be a good area to buy," another trader said.
He said the market continued to face resistance at 20,300 and 20,500.
The May MSCI Taiwan index contract ended at 333.4 against its opening 328.0 on volume of 1,501 lots.
